text:
Digital Extremes says Warframe's imminent Tau update is practically big enough to be a sequel as it reveals new details, including dog walking

Warframe's latest devstream has just gone live, revealing more about the new Tau solar system players will be able to explore as part of December's "massive" new update, which arrives on 9th December. Additions include a two-hour long quest, new explorable areas, and even chill nighttime dog walking.

text:
Don't expect a GTA set outside the USA anytime soon, as Rockstar has "not had a lot of conversations over doing it anywhere else"

Would Rockstar really set a future Grand Theft Auto game outside of the United States? The concept's been mooted recently, particularly in reporting on a recent Rockstar interview with The Guardian, where co-studio head Rob Nelson quipped: "Never say never." But speaking to Eurogamer in another interview since then, I would say it's unlikely.

author: Eurogamer
text:
At last, I've finally played Faraway, an enigma I've been waiting 16 years to see

For 16 years I've been watching the skies. It was 16 years ago, back in the first giddy rush of smartphone gaming, that I saw a 30-second trailer for a game set in space. It was a game about a comet, hurtling through the unknown. It wasn't clear what you'd do in this game, whether you'd control the comet itself or the space it moved through. It wasn't clear if this was some kind of arcade game, or a new spin on the endless runner, or even just a kind of cosmic sandbox. All I had was the comet and a name: Faraway. Faraway! I was captivated.
